issues.title: Acceptance Criteria Mismatch
issues.why: The child module (01-research-index) claims to have 6 GWT criteria in its checklist, but the actual 97-acceptance-criteria.md file for that sub-module is missing from the provided context.
issues.fix: Provide the file spec/10-research/01-research-index/97-acceptance-criteria.md containing the 6 GWT cases.

issues.title: Domain Path Validation Ambiguity
issues.why: The JSON schema requires 'domains' to be relpaths to spec modules but does not define if these must be validated against the filesystem or a known list during runtime.
issues.fix: Add a 'Verifies' clause to AC-RESEARCH-03 stating that domain strings must resolve to existing directories in the spec/ tree.

issues.title: Missing Mermaid Source Files
issues.why: The overview references standalone .mmd files (e.g., lifecycle-top-research.mmd) which are not provided in the file list, though the code is inlined.
issues.fix: Include the raw .mmd files in the module file inventory to match the 'File Inventory' table.
